risks: The log excerpt is truncated before the actual native-image run failure, so the root cause is unconfirmed. The build output shows kotlin-reflect-1.6.10 on the image classpath next to kotlin-stdlib-2.5.0-Beta1, so a Kotlin version mismatch is a possible cause. Check this when reproducing locally.
The daemon tests set CompilerSystemProperties and reset the LogManager. Verify these still behave under native image on 2.5.0-Beta1.
